user_story: As a registered user, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.

positive.title: Successful login with valid credentials
positive.expected_result: User is redirected to their account dashboard

positive.title: Successful login with remember me option
positive.expected_result: User is redirected to their account dashboard and remains logged in on the next visit

negative.title: Login with unregistered email
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is not registered

negative.title: Login with incorrect password
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password is incorrect

negative.title: Login with empty email field
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email field cannot be empty

negative.title: Login with empty password field
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password field cannot be empty

edge.title: Login attempt with special characters in email
steps: Enter an email address with special characters (e.g., '!@#$.')
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email format is invalid

edge.title: Login with extremely long email
steps: Enter an email address longer than 255 characters
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is too long

edge.title: Login attempt with XSS attack in email field
steps: Enter a registered email address with an XSS script (e.g., '<script>alert(1)</script>')
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed and no script is executed
